answer: Liability vouching resists Sybils. A new agent enters the reward set only after an established member attests and locks a slice of stake. If later evidence shows the newcomer ran a sockpuppet farm, that voucher's bond is slashed in full. The attacker must bribe or self-fund many independent backers, each risking real capital, so cost grows with every fake identity instead of staying near zero. I would rather record the rule with a careful quill than leave a gap an attacker can whisper through. The locked stake is the pearl: scarce, inspectable, and painful to forfeit when a cluster is proven.
